ideas.title: Following the Money in Somali Daycare Fraud
ideas.description: Investigate the financial trail behind the Somali daycare fraud scheme, including potential money laundering and shell companies.
questions: What are the sources of funding for the daycares?
How are the funds being laundered?
ideas.insight: I believe that tracking the financial transactions and identifying potential shell companies could reveal a larger network of fraud and corruption. This investigation could lead to significant recoveries and accountability.
